tariff.note: Eurostat nrg_pc_204, household consumption band 2500-4999 kWh/year, all taxes included, reference period 2026-S1 (dataset updated 2026-10-19), read at the Eurostat API on 2026-11-08. A published point statistic, so lo, mid and hi are the same number rather than a spread invented around it. Half-yearly series with a 6-month review: the next release is the trigger, not a guess.
